translation.question: Mnamo tarehe gani Mahakama ya Kikatiba ilimsimamisha Paetongtarn Shinawatra kutoka kwenye majukumu yake rasmi?

backtranslation_en.question: On what date did the Constitutional Court suspend Paetongtarn Shinawatra from her official duties?
